Номер компонента внутри аппарата в MAVLi: A component's number within a vehicle in MAVLink (autopilot 1, camera 100, gimbal 154, etc.). Together with the system ID it forms the address.
Номер модели 0–63, который пульт сообщае: A model number 0–63 that the radio reports to the RF module; ExpressLRS uses it for Model Match, and a copied model inherits the original's number.
Номер ножки GPIO, которой управляет реле: The GPIO pin number driven by relay n in ArduPilot (before 4.5: RELAY_PIN, RELAY_PIN2…). The number comes from GPIO(g) in the board's hwdef; if the pin belongs to a PWM output, that output needs SERVOn_FUNCTION = -1.
Номер узла на шине DroneCAN (1–127). Зад: A node's number on the DroneCAN bus (1–127). Set statically or assigned by the dynamic node allocation (DNA) server on the autopilot.
Номер, который связывает физический выхо: A number that links a physical output to the source of its value: 101–112 Motor, 201–208 Servo, 301–306 Peripheral via Actuator Set, 400 Landing Gear, 401 Parachute, 407–412 RC AUX, 430 Gripper, 2000 Camera Trigger. The list is output_functions.yaml; mixer_module converts the value to microseconds by MIN/MAX/CENT/REV.
Нормированные значения каналов в трёх мо: The normalized channel values at three moments match the reference ±0.005, slots 1, 4, 6 and the modes Stabilized, Altitude, Position named exactly, the arm, kill and Return states match, including the channel reverse and the −0.25 threshold
Нужны высота от дальномера и угловая ско: Requires rangefinder altitude and gyro angular rate.

Inclusive (FZ) is a zone you must stay inside; exclusive (NFZ) is one you must not enter. Each zone has an action at the boundary: NONE, AVOID, POS_HOLD or RTH. CLI commands geozone and geozone vertex, feature GEOZONE, a board with more than 512 KB of flash.
Обобщение обратной матрицы для неквадрат: A generalization of the matrix inverse to non-square and singular B: it gives the minimum-norm u that solves B·u = target (or the closest one in the least-squares sense). PX4 builds the mixer this way for any geometry and recomputes it when a motor fails.

It shows only the output of the command run in it; messages from other modules are read with dmesg. On the flight controller it is nsh (NuttX), in SITL it is pxh.
